title: Tracy Business under a worn system: only a filled button takes the accent fill; its outline and text-link buttons (is-style-outline, is-style-link) keep their kind and read the readable accent
steps: S1: From packages/design/tracy-ds-slot run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/cms.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, '# fail' and the result of the test named in expect.
expect: 'WordPress: an outline or text-link button keeps its kind — only a filled button takes the accent fill' is ok: in the MotherDuck variation for templates/wordpress-tracy-business.json every selector of the primary-button rule contains '.wp-block-button:not(.is-style-outline):not(.is-style-link) > ', and the accent-text rule names '.tracy .wp-block-button.is-style-link .wp-block-button__link' (stopped at the kept bands).
evidence: tasks/evidence/followups-2026-10-10/p6-dsdata/tracy-business-links.txt and tracy-business-services-*.png: on the restored tracy-business/wp7 release under MotherDuck, 'All services →' was a filled #6fc2ff pill; with the narrowed selector it is transparent with #4d6c84 text (4.63:1), verdicts 8/12 before and after, controls 0.
fence: which Tracy Business buttons the system fills; not their shapes (the button rule still reaches every button)

tests: WordPress: an outline or text-link button keeps its kind — only a filled button takes the accent fill
